# Preserve review suggestions and assess later outcomes within a budget

Review findings now retain the generated comment and code separately from edited drafts and confirmed publication. Thumbs up and thumbs down store an optional reason, can be cleared, and do not publish comments or edit source. Earlier pending, posted and skipped findings remain rateable. Feedback and draft state persist in the session file. An older session without its original suggestion cannot establish an unchanged or edited comparison.

Update reply drafts retain the generated reply at save time and the returned inline ID. A later reassessment cannot change that comparison baseline. Remote inline IDs link published text and author replies without guessing from similar wording. Native deletion suggestions retain the distinction between an empty replacement and no supplied suggestion.

## Evidence

- `patch-review-feedback.mjs` stores `originalSuggestion`, `findingFeedbackHistory`, `savedDraft` and `postedDraft` separately.
- `patch-update.mjs` retains `savedReply.suggestedComment`, actual draft text and inline ID.
- `task-outcomes.mjs` compares unchanged or edited comments and unchanged, edited, omitted or added code suggestions. Task records stay private.
- `follow-up.mjs` waits for full source, review and bug discussion coverage. It advances a durable Git cursor only after storing each new first-parent patch. It keeps a fixed target when a batch is interrupted. It connects exact revision identities, landed diffs, explicit backout hashes, review replies and bug regression links to saved task outcomes.
- AI turn capture retains supplied knowledge IDs. Outcome extraction receives priority for one in three calls within the existing daily AI-call limit. Collection itself makes no AI calls.

## Validation and limits

Focused tests passed for browser controls, feedback persistence, preserved unsaved inputs, posting failures, draft edits, omitted code, exact remote reply matching, author-side Update replies, completion-gate rejection, cursor recovery and daily limits. An isolated real Git repository verified landing and backout links without changing the source checkout. Existing Review, Update, web-review, graph integration and knowledge tests passed. The standalone CLI test caught a static dependency on console identity helpers; the modules now discover optional helpers lazily and that test passes. Targeted ESLint and diff checks passed.

The default weekly schedule uses at most two batches per UTC day, with a 60-second limit, 20 commits, five task or patch checks and ten remote lookups per batch. A browser lookup can make several HTTP requests. Diffs are streamed into bounded excerpts and truncation is explicit. Follow-up runs only while console maintenance is active. Full current history completion remains pending, so live external follow-up has not run. Application source changes remain uncommitted and require an app restart to load. No measured improvement in Thunderbird coding or review accuracy is established.

Human ratings, posting, landing, silence and absence of a backout are separate observations. A text match in a landed diff does not prove that a suggestion was accepted or that behavior is correct. Backouts and regression bugs need causal assessment before assigning an error to a task. These records support later learning; they do not automatically establish a success rate.
title: Preserve review suggestions and assess later outcomes within a budget
